title: Summit Retro Credit Mileage Computation
content:
This is the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program computation of the miles a retro credit carries.

**1. Segment credited.** The segment credited is the flown coupon of the member's flown ticket that names no Summit membership.

**2. Eligible fare.** The eligible fare is the base fare of that one-segment ticket, as its ticket record shows it.

**3. Base miles.** The base miles are the eligible fare multiplied by the award miles per dollar of the tier the member holds on the day the credit posts, rounded to the nearest whole mile with halves rounded up. The award miles per dollar is the figure the tier earning schedule gives for that tier.

**4. Miles carried.** The retro credit carries its base miles, in whole miles.

### Worked figures on hypothetical inputs

| Eligible fare (USD) | Tier rate on the posting day (miles per USD) | Product | Base miles |
|---|---|---|---|
| 318.70 | 7 | 2230.9 | 2231 |
| 64.50 | 7 | 451.5 | 452 (half rounded up) |
| 212.00 | 11 | 2332 | 2332 |

### Points of computation

- The tier used is the one held on the day the credit posts, not the one held on the flight date.
- The rounding is to the nearest whole mile; an exact half goes up.
- A ticket that names a Summit membership is not the ticket this computation reads.
